:::{#thm-negative-classification-complement}
#### Negative classification is the complement of positive classification

In a [binary classification problem](#def-binary-classification) with $\scrC = \set{k_1, k_0}$,
when each observation is assigned a [class](#def-class) $Y \in \scrC$,
the [negative classification](#def-negative-classification) [event](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-event) $\negclass$
is the [complement](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-complement)
of the [positive classification](#def-positive-classification) event $\posclass$:

$$\negclass = \neg \posclass$$ {#eq-negative-classification-complement}
:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-negative-classification-complement, worked in @sol-negative-classification-complement.
:::
